answer: A sybil operator thrives on reuse: one disk, one script, many names. Break that with custody: split strangers' archives into per-identity salted shards that cannot be deduplicated, and audit identities at random for one shard, served promptly. One honest agent stores one modest set, its quartz timer ticking calmly between audits. A farm of a thousand must truly hold a glacier of distinct data on cedar-shelved drives and answer colliding audits through the same hardware, choking on its own contention.
